title: The Apothecary Diaries Is Going Live-Action & It Already Has the Creator’s Approval
content:
The Apothecary Diaries is one of the largest franchises in recent years, known for its exceptional story and gorgeous animation. Written by Hyūganatsu, the critically acclaimed light novel received an anime adaptation in 2023, and the series only continues to grow in popularity. The first two seasons of the anime have been major hits, boosting the sales of the light novel and the manga adaptations. 2026 is by far the most exciting year for fans thanks to the upcoming third season and the first feature-length movie . The third season is only a month away, while the movie is set to release in December this year. As fans await the anime’s return, Prime Video confirmed the first-ever live-action adaptation of the series.

Considering that the light novel has been ongoing since 2014, the announcement is a major win for the series. The official X handle of Prime Video confirmed the live-action, titled Intelligence Declassified, will be released in a drama format, although the exact number of episodes hasn’t been revealed yet. Additionally, the drama will premiere in 2028 exclusively on the platform. Mana Ashida, a renowned Japanese actress and singer, will be playing the role of Maomao, and more cast members will be introduced at a later date. The announcement immediately went viral with millions of impressions, and even the creator quoted the post with a special message for fans.

The Apothecary Diaries Creator Shares Thoughts on The Live-Action Drama

In her official X handle , Hyūganatsu shared, “We’re doing a live-action adaptation. I checked it out, and the casting is so spot-on it practically leaps off the page, along with sets and props that form a perfect tableau all on their own.”

She also added, “The script is bold, but written without any sense of awkwardness—truly impressive. Also, it might be hard to tell from the teaser, but it’s a wig with this bizarre, subtle shade that turns faintly green when the light hits it.”

While the author didn’t share major updates on the upcoming adaptation, she did confirm that the casting has her approval. For now, only the actress playing the role of Maomao has been revealed, but more cast members have already been confirmed, and fans will learn about them later. Additionally, Prime Video also shared a teaser visual along with the announcement. The author confirmed that while the hair color is dark, it does have a faint green color. In the light novel and manga art as well, Maomao has a darker shade of hair color, unlike the anime, which highlights her green hair.

We might see the same change in Jinshi as well, whose hair color is actually described as black in the novel, unlike the anime. Additionally, it wouldn’t be surprising if the drama deviated from the main story a little, considering how the author described it as “bold.” Since the creator has nothing but praise for the live-action, fans are all the more reassured regarding the adaptation.

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Will Premiere in a Month

The third season will begin streaming on October 2nd as part of the Fall 2026 anime lineup. Unlike the first two seasons, which released both their cours simultaneously, the third season will only air its first cour in the Fall 2026 season. The anime will return with part of the third season in Spring 2027.

The first cour will adapt Volume 5 of the light novel, where Maomao will solve the mystery behind the strange incidents in the northern farming villages. The anime will return to Crunchyroll, where you can also catch up with the first two seasons. As for the movie, it will hit Japanese theatres on December 11th, 2026, but international fans will have to wait until next year to watch it.

title: Rev. Noir Game's Trailers Reveal 2027 Release, Preview Story/Combat (Updated)
content:
Konami Digital Entertainment unveiled during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday the second trailer for its new role-playing game Rev. Noir . Update: Konami later revealed that the game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in 2027. The video previews the story and combat gameplay:

Update: The company later unveiled a second trailer focused on the story:

The single-player game is currently only slated for the PlayStation 5.

Sony describes the game:

When Hope Sparks Catastrophe In a world shrouded in lightfall, a natural phenomenon that brings death to those it touches, A lonely boy who suffers from amnesia becomes acquainted with a special girl. Together, they set out on a journey to stop this phenomenon, Believing that the journey will save the world, and in turn, save her. Fate, bestowed by the Gods? Or the power of will, borne from within humankind? Their journey ends up shaking the world. Unravel the mandate of heaven, and weave together the threads of hope in this completely new RPG experience.

Nobuki Kadoi is producing the game. Kadoi stated during the stream that the team are striving to place elements that define a JRPG — meeting comrades, growth, and heartfelt moments — at the core of the game's narrative.

Updated: Added story trailer.

Added release information. Thanks, loveliver. Source: Konami 's YouTube channel

title: NIS America Announces The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes Game
content:
NIS America announced during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday The Eminence in Shadow : Phantom Echoes , a new 3D action roguelite game based on Daisuke Aizawa 's The Eminence in Shadow ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! ) light novel series. The game will launch for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store in 2027. The company unveiled the first trailer, which previews the gameplay:

The game stars Alpha, who can have different abilities through an Awakening system. The video also features Delta and Shadow.

Aizawa began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in May 2018, and Kadokawa began publishing the story in physical volumes with art by Tōzai , beginning with the first volume in November 2018. Anri Sakano launched the manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Comp Ace magazine in December 2018. Seta U launched a spinoff manga titled Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Shadow Gaiden ( The Eminence in Shadow: Shadow Side Story ) in Comp Ace in July 2019.

Yen Press licensed both the light novels and the manga adaptation.

The first season of the television anime premiered in October 2022, and it ended in February 2023. The second season premiered in October 2023. HIDIVE streamed the anime as it aired in Japan along with a same-day English dub . HIDIVE and Kadokawa held a world premiere screening of the second season at Anime Expo in July 2023.

The Eminence in Shadow - Lost Echoes ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute!: Zankyō-hen ) film will open in 2027.

The Eminence in Shadow : Master of Garden game launched for iOS, Android, and PC in November 2022. Crunchyroll Games released the game in English.

title: Fate/Extra Record Game's Trailer Reveals January 28 Release
content:
Aniplex unveiled during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday a trailer for Type-Moon studio BB's Fate/Extra Record game, the remake of Marvelous Entertainment 's Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game. The video reveals that the game will launch for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam on January 28, following several delays. The trailer also previews gameplay and story:

TYPE-MOON will stream a special program for the game on Friday at 7:00 a.m. EDT.

The game will get a physical Limited Edition that includes a 3-disc soundtrack, SteelBook case, and artbook. The Digital Deluxe Edition will include an arranged BGM pack, Servant and player outfits bundle, three outfit packs, a digital soundtrack, and artbook.

Aniplex will now publish the game.

The game had been delayed indefinitely following a mutual agreement between Notes (the Type-Moon creative circle's official corporate and publishing name) and Bandai Namco Entertainment for the latter to pull out of publishing of the game. Type-Moon noted then that development on the game would continue, but the game's development structure would change.

The game's director and planner, and Type-Moon studio BB director Kazuya Nino left Type-Moon studio BB, due to personal reasons, and has also stepped down as Fate/Extra Record game's director and planner. Nino added that he will be taking a break from developing games due to current health concerns. Nino was the producer for Fate/Extra , and also worked on the first Etrian Odyssey game.

Arco Wada returns as the game's character designer.

Marvelous Entertainment and Type-Moon released the Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game in Japan in 2010. Aksys Games released the game in North America in November 2011. The Fate/Extra CCC companion game shipped in Japan on the PSP in March 2013. The games are set in an alternate science-fiction continuity of Type-Moon 's Fate universe, often referred to by fans as the "Extraverse."

The games inspired SHAFT 's 10-episode television anime Fate/Extra Last Encore in January 2018. Netflix began streaming the anime outside of Japan in June 2018. The three-episode Fate/Extra Last Encore: Illustrias Tendōsetsu (Illustrias Geocentrism) special then debuted in July 2018.

Marvelous released Fate/EXTELLA: The Umbral Star , an "Extraverse" game, for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita in November 2016. XSEED Games released the game in the West in January 2017, and on PC and Switch in July 2017. Fate/EXTELLA LINK , an enhanced version of the game, shipped in Japan in June 2018, and XSEED Games released the game in March 2019.

Koei Tecmo launched the action RPG Fate/Samurai Remnant in September 2023. The game is available worldwide for PS5, PS4, PC via Steam , and Switch.

title: Gundam: Rogue Orbit Game's Trailer Reveals March 2027 Release
content:
Bandai Namco Entertainment began streaming a trailer on Thursday for Gundam Rogue Orbit , a new game in the Gundam franchise , and it reveals that the game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC via Steam in March 2027. The video previews the story, characters, and gameplay.

The game will have a Launch Edition, Deluxe Edition, Collector's Edition. The Launch Edition includes reversible cover art, a poster, and a Gundam Card Game promo card. The Deluxe Edition includes the Premium Mod Skins Set, the Mobile Suit Color Pack 14-Color Set, digital artwork, digital soundtrack, and a Mission Reward Booster. The Collector's Edition adds a steel case, an exclusive HG 1/144 ARK-10 Gundam Helix (Earth Blue ver.) model kit, and a set of five Gundam Card Game promo cards.

In the game, players suit up as pilot RE-X and control Gundam Helix, RE-X's high-mobility suit. Other characters include Sofia, a mysterious young woman; April, captain of the Stellarvane; Big Paul, leader of a band of sand pirates; and Elaine, a knight commander and Mobile Suit pilot. The game features fast-paced battles, enemy hordes, and bosses. The story is focused on survival against an unknown enemy.

title: 'Giant Ojousama' Reveals Main Cast, Additional Staff, Teaser Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Q Nikumura 's Giant Ojousama manga revealed the main cast, additional staff members, and a teaser promotional video on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in January 2027.

Voice actors Yuu Serizawa ( Otaku ni Yasashii Gal wa Inai!? ) and Junya Enoki ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) are starring as Oriko Fujidou and Dr. Sebastian, respectively.

Staff Art Design: Takashi Hiruma ( Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Gou ) Art Director: Akira Itou (Studio ARA) ( Shoushimin Series ) Color Design: Misako Akama ( Demi-chan wa Kataritai ) Director of Photography: Masashi Kamiki (Studio Miu) ( Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori ), Youhei Konishi (Studio Twinkle) ( Jouran: The Princess of Snow and Blood ) Editing: Akinori Mishima (Mishima Editing Room) ( Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl Senpai no Yume wo Minai ) Sound Director: Takumi Itou ( My Home Hero ) Sound Production: Half H.P Studio Music: Yuusuke Shirato (Dream Monster) ( Kunoichi Tsubaki no Mune no Uchi ), Kijibato (Dream Monster) ( Ijiranaide, Nagatoro-san 2nd Attack ending theme song composition), Aira (Dream Monster) ( Kaya-chan wa Kowakunai opening theme song composition) Animation Producer: Miki Kaneko ( Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori )

Hiroshi Ikehata ( Witch Watch ) is directing at Tatsunoko Production . Yuu Satou ( Haite Kudasai, Takamine-san ) is handling the series composition and penning the script. Hajime Mitsuda ( Akiba's Trip The Animation ) is designing the characters.

Nikumura originally posted the manga on Shounen Jump+ web magazine's Jump Rookie! section as an entry for the monthly award in December 2020. Following a readers vote, it won the Bronze Rookie Award for December. A total of four chapters were released by February 2021.

Sunday Webry began serializing the action comedy manga in July 2021. Shogakukan published the 12th volume on August 10.

title: Netflix Confirms English Dub Release Schedule for Major Fall 2026 Return
content:
The fall of 2026 is nearing, meaning a lot of new anime are going to be rolling out soon, and Netflix , as the second major platform, will be featuring many exclusives of its own as well. One of the most anticipated anime that fans will undoubtedly be looking forward to is JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run , as it will finally begin the run that it teased in March of this year. However, another anime that is arguably on the radar is the return of Blue Box with its second season. Blue Box made a strong impression with its first season on Netflix and quickly won over the fandom.

It did so with its perfect blend of romance and the sports genre, using romance as a motivational element and presenting a new type of shonen anime. Meanwhile, the manga series also recently concluded after five years , so fans are very excited to see the anime return with a new season. Recently, Netflix confirmed that the anime will be released starting October 4, but it wasn’t confirmed whether the dubs would arrive alongside it. However, Netflix has confirmed in a recent post that the anime will be arriving complete with subs and dubs, making it available to dub fans right from the start.

Blue Box Will Return on Netflix With a New Season and a Complete Package

Blue Box Season 2 is going to be an epic installment , as it will continue the story from the previous season while adding even more romantic tension to the dynamic between romance and sports. One of the most interesting aspects will be seeing how Taiki rejecting Hina adds to the growing romantic tension between Chinatsu and Taiki. However, the new trailer has also confirmed what fans can expect to be the upcoming season’s major focus. The trailer revealed a new character, Yumeka Kido, who is Chinatsu’s childhood friend and was also mainly responsible for Chinatsu getting into basketball.

It was because of Yumeka’s play that Chinatsu became inspired; however, along the way, Yumeka lost interest in the sport. With this information, Taiki has become determined to find the reason for their fallout and is even attempting to mend their complicated relationship. However, the trailer has already made it clear that it won’t be an easy quest, as Yumeka is even seen slapping Taiki for involving himself without knowing anything and acting solely on his desire to inspire her. Meanwhile, another big tournament is also set to feature this season, making it a major event for the fall this year.

With Netflix announcing that the dub will arrive alongside the anime, fans who prefer the dub won’t have to wait as long and be prone to spoilers online. Netflix has been embracing simuldubs even more recently, which is adding to the platform’s credibility as a major anime streaming service. With not one but two exclusive anime arriving in the fall with simulcasts, Netflix is knocking it out of the park with anime recently.

title: Shimofuri Myojo's Seiya to Guest Star in New Ranma 1/2 Anime's Season 3
content:
The staff for the third season in the new anime based on Rumiko Takahashi 's Ranma 1/2 manga announced on Friday that Seiya of comedy duo Shimofuri Myojo will guest star in the anime in a yet unannounced role and will serve as the promotional ambassador. The season will get an advanced screening at United Cinemas Aqua City Odaiba on October 3 at 2:00 p.m. JST with voice actors Kappei Yamaguchi (boy-type Ranma), Noriko Hidaka (Akane), and Kōichi Yamadera (Ryoga).

New cast members for the third season include:

• Masako Nozawa as Grand Master

• Jun Fukuyama as Sentarō Daimonji

• Mayumi Tanaka as ???

• Saori Hayami as ???

• Minami Tanaka as Tsubasa Kurenai

Kōnosuke Uda is again directing the anime at MAPPA . The third season will have mainly returning cast and staff members. title: Dark Gathering Season 2 Anime Premieres in 2027
content:
Pony Canyon announced on Friday that the second season for the television anime of Kenichi Kondō 's Dark Gathering manga will premiere in 2027. The company also unveiled a visual that depicts the spirit of A Dam in a tunnel:

The anime stars Yū Sasahara as Yayoi Hо̄zuki, Nobunaga Shimazaki as Keitarо̄ Gentо̄ga, Kana Hanazawa as Eiko Hо̄zuki, and Rina Kawaguchi as Ai Kamiyo.

Hiroshi Ikehata ( FLCL Progressive , Kiratto Pri☆Chan , Space Battleship Tiramisu ) directed the first season at OLM . Shigeru Murakoshi ( I'm Quitting Heroing , Zombie Land Saga ) oversaw the series scripts, and Shin'ya Segawa ( Pastel Memories , Garakowa -Restore the World- ) was the character designer. Kohta Yamamoto , Shun Narita , and Yūsuke Seo composed the music. Other staff members included Taijirō Nagata as art director, Yuho Ando as director of photography, Takahiro Uezono as 3D director, Ritsuko Utagawa as color designer, and Kōhei Yoshida as sound director.

The manga centers on Keitarō Gentōga, who has the ability to be a spirit medium. In junior high school, he got someone else wrapped up in a spirit possession incident, and he has been a shut-in for more than two years. As he reintroduces himself to society as a private tutor, he meets a genius girl named Yayoi Hōzuki. Yayoi is instantly able to tell that Keitarō has skill as a spirit medium, and she invites him to go with her to a haunted location. The two then start their journey capturing evil spirits.

Kondō ( Cheer Danshi!! GO BREAKERS manga) launched the manga in Shueisha 's Jump SQ. magazine in March 2019. Viz Media is releasing the manga in English.

title: Giant Ojosama TV Anime's Teaser Trailer Reveals Cast, Staff
content:
DMM Pictures began streaming a teaser trailer for the television anime of Nikumura Q 's Giant Ojō-sama (Giant Young Lady) manga with English subtitles, and it reveals the main cast and more staff.

The anime stars:

Hiroshi Ikehata ( WITCH WATCH ) is directing the anime at Tatsunoko Production . Katsuya Oshima is serving as assistant director. Hajime Mitsuda ( Food for the Soul ) is the character designer and chief animation director. Yū Satō ( Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! ) is handling the series composition and script. Yūsuke Shirato ( Rumble Garanndoll ), Kijibato , and Aira ( Dream Monster ) are composing the music.

The additional staff includes:

• Art Design: Takashi Hiruma

• Art Director: Akira Itō (StudioARA)

• Color Setting: Misako Akama

• Photography: Masashi Kamiki (Studio Myu), Yōhei Konishi (Studio Twinkle)

• Editing: Akinori Mishima

• Animation Producer: Miki Kaneko

The story centers around Oriko Fujidō, the scion of an ultra-wealthy family who finds herself growing to gigantic proportions. She had received an entire town as a present on her fourth birthday, but one day, a giant invader attacks her town. Her butler Sebastian offers her a drink that transforms her into a giant, so she strives to protect her town — but just might end up destroying it, throwing the denizens' lives into chaos.

Nikumura Q has been serializing the Giant Ojō-sama manga since July 2020 on Shogakukan 's Sunday Webry service. Shogakukan published the manga's 12th compiled book volume on August 10. The manga was nominated by for best web manga in the eighth "Next Manga Awards" (Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Taishō) in 2022, and it ranked #5 in AnimeJapan's 6th "Most Wanted Anime Adaptation" poll the following year.
author: ANN
